$description: SajdaTime spacing tokens, release 1.6. Tested against app/src/main/java/com/sajdatime/app/ui/theme/Spacing.kt (object Space) by DesignTokensTest. Units are dp on Android and pt on iOS (1dp maps to 1pt). A gap is chosen by how closely two things belong together, never by eye. Never two different gaps for the same relationship on one screen.

tight.usage: A title and the line that belongs to it; a label and its value; a sheet or card title (titleLarge or smaller) and its line.

related.usage: A paragraph and the button that acts on it; two buttons stacked or side by side; a text field and its button; a section heading and the field it introduces; a divider and what is either side of it; a progress line under its button.

paragraph.usage: One paragraph and the next in the same block; stacked choice cards; summary rows; a screen headline (headlineMedium or larger) and its paragraph.

group.usage: One group (text plus its button) and the next; card padding; a block of several lines and its button row; a dialog's help text and the choices under it; screen gutter.

section.usage: One section of a screen and the next; a button and the next section; a group of buttons and a different group; the last choice card and setup's Back and Continue.

layout.$description: Fixed layout metrics. Not in Space because they are component sizes, not gaps. Documented in docs/design-system/02-foundations.md; enforced by review, not by the test, except where noted.

screenGutter.usage: Horizontal page margin on phone screens and inside Settings groups.

screenTitleGutter.usage: ScreenTitle start padding (Qibla, Settings, My prayers).

minTouchTarget.usage: Every tappable thing, drawn smaller or not. Meets Apple's 44pt.

listRowMin.usage: Minimum height of a list or Settings row, a switch row, a jama'ah row.

contentMaxWidth.usage: Content column cap on tablets and wide windows, centred; the sky stays full width.

bottomBarClearance.usage: Every scrolling tab screen ends with BottomBarClearance(): the glass bar's measured height, so it grows with large text. Never a fixed number.
